_comment: Sequential chaining: each video clip uses the previous clip's last frame as its first frame via ref + extract. This creates visual continuity across clips — the ending of one scene becomes the start of the next.

project.name: Day in the Life - Time Lapse
project.description: A continuous visual sequence showing sunrise to sunset

source.text: As the first light breaks over the horizon, the world begins to stir.
By noon, the city is alive with energy. Streets bustle, markets hum, and shadows shrink to nothing.
As the sun dips below the skyline, golden light paints every surface. The day draws to a quiet close.

clips._comment: First clip uses a generated image as its first frame (no previous clip to chain from)
